results.title: [Agentic Workflow] LLM-Assisted Text Analysis: From Open-Ended Responses to Structured Insights
results.description:
A hands-on workshop on using large language models to classify short text data, such as survey responses, feedback comments, or research abstracts. Participants will learn how to create a simple codebook, use it to guide LLM classification, and check the results through human review. No coding or machine learning background is required. Researchers and professional staff often work with short, open-ended text that needs to be organised into meaningful categories. Manual coding can be slow, while machine learning approaches may require technical expertise.

This workshop introduces a practical human-in-the-loop workflow: define categories, build a simple codebook, prompt the LLM, review the output, and refine the approach. The focus is on using AI in a structured, transparent, and low-barrier way.

(Complete any 3 workshops in the Agentic Workflow Series to earn a digital badge for your LinkedIn profile!)
